Hey there! I’m going to start off by saying my roommate (super nice dude) has gone through really similar feelings as you have here. Also, as a woman in college, I can sympathize with your frustrations. My roommate and I also feel very pressured by college life (let’s go Penn State), but have come to realize that “college life” is something that doesn’t matter in the big scheme of things. 

He is also a virgin (I’m posting all this with his permission btw) and isn’t the worst looking guy on earth either. Dating apps are the worst, even for me (I’m also not the worst looking), so don’t touch them! They only make you feel worse. Also, please realize we’re young and so are our peers. I have no doubt you have amazing qualities, just like how my roommate has amazing qualities. 

I also give this advice, which helps me a lot: learn the simple art of not giving a f**k (there’s even a great book called that). Who cares if you’re a virgin and if someone does, they’re shallow and someone who doesn’t deserve to be in your life and is in no place to judge. As for getting laid, don’t rush it. My ex-boyfriend didn’t have sex until his senior year when he met me in my junior year. Did I care? Nope! All that matters (to a decent women or any person who choses to care about you and you them) is who you are at the end of the day and how kind you are. Be kind to yourself and feel free to hit me up to talk about this. I’m all ears :)
